sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 107)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, three 1950s frontier broadcasts of *The Lone Ranger* for Cheerios, two gritty NYC police procedural investigations on *21st Precinct* starring Everett Sloane (directed by John Meston), and Peter Lorre starring in Cornell Woolrich's psychological horror thriller on *Nightmare* (1950–1954):
